june_parity.caveat: R38: membership revenue moves revenue/GM whenever goals.json carries mem keys — June parity holds ONLY when the goals payload has no mem block. R41 changed FLAG CLASSIFICATION only. R42 adds assumed install pay only on Install-bucket jobs ≤14 days old at the data-snapshot moment — mature-month rebuilds byte-identical (verified). R43 paces the three fixed monthly $ (Holiday Pay / PTO / onboarding × $4,000) by the engine's elapsedFrac — on a CLOSED month elapsedFrac=1, paced = full monthly, and the June A/B vs R42 is byte-identical (RAW modulo builtAt; 12/12 rendered panes across 4 tabs × 3 scopes; every pre-existing summary key; verified 2026-08-05 with the baseline fixed values loaded). A YOUNG window legitimately moves: Direct Labor carries only the elapsed share of the fixed $ (MTD = monthly × elapsedFrac), so mid-month GM/CP read higher — and more honest — than R42, and the Pace view carries exactly the full monthly fixed $ instead of inflating it by ÷ elapsedFrac. That is the point of R43, not drift. R44 is DISPLAY-ONLY (full-screen job card + project rollup, built on row click from the engine's own per-job records) — it cannot move any number: June A/B vs R43 verified 12/12 rendered panes byte-identical, RAW byte-identical (modulo builtAt), every summary key identical. R45 adds a per-system multiplier to the assumed install pay — it can only move jobs <=14 days old at the data-snapshot moment, so the mature-June rebuild is unchanged to the cent (verified: jobs, flag set, per-job rev/purch/labor/GM/instTop and all 71 pre-existing summary keys x 3 scopes identical; 9/12 rendered panes byte-identical, the 3 Summary panes differ ONLY by the Reconciliation label gaining 'x systems sold on the invoice'). RAW is NOT byte-identical vs R44: parseDisc now serializes a per-job `units` map (+9,745 bytes on June) — this is the one intended payload change and it is what makes the multiplier survive a saved copy.

release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.
notes: R44 (2026-08-06, per Stephen): FULL-SCREEN JOB CARD + PROJECT ROLLUP - 'on the jobs tab, when you expand a job, the labor breakdown is condensed so you cant see the numbers... that table only expands partially, it should fill the screen... since it has the job# and project# it can connect jobs to projects... we need to know what the total revenue, discount, labor %, purchase%, Gross margin %, Gross Profit $ is for all the jobs on the project combined.' Three fixes, all display-only. (1) The old inline <tr class=det> expansion rendered INSIDE table.jobs, so nested cells inherited white-space:nowrap and the long labor-build labels overlapped/clipped the numbers (the Techs line clipped mid-name at 1600px). (2) It sat inside the gridwrap 70vh scroll box, so it only ever opened partially. Clicking a job now opens a fixed full-screen overlay card (.jdov, body-level, outside the table): waterfall / labor build (assumed-vs-actual COM and install plan-vs-posted inline on wrapped readable lines + a Direct Labor total row) / commission derivation, close via X, Esc or backdrop click. (3) When the job carries a Project #, the card adds the Project rollup: every sibling job on that project in the loaded month (revenue-desc rows: rev, counting disc, labor $ %, purchases $ %, GM % $, current job highlighted, member rows click through to their own card) plus six combined tiles - Total revenue, Discounts (+ project disc % of book -> comm rate off the engine's own project tier), Labor %, Purchases %, GM % (gm-banded pill), GP $ - because one compliant project sale is often split across several jobs/crews (dig/drywall/pipe/backfill) and one job can margin poorly while the PROJECT as sold is healthy. Aggregation is pure display arithmetic over the engine's per-job records (same convention as the grid TOTAL row); the engine's project grouping/tier math (computeAll 'projects' map) is UNTOUCHED. Notes state the month-window caveat, the subs/permits-in-GM reconciliation and benign-credit exclusion. buildSaveHtml splices PAGE0 so an open card never serializes into a saved copy. Verified 2026-08-06 (jsdom, June exports, frozen build.js, goals=skip): gates 6/6 both engines, 3,902 jobs / $6,087,636 / GM 55.3% exact, RAW byte-identical (builtAt normalized), 12/12 rendered panes (Summary+recon/P&L/Jobs/Trends x Branch/HVAC/Plumb) byte-identical, every summary key identical; 39/39 A/B+smoke checks green incl. combined stats reconciling to independent sums to the cent on a live 5-job project (P627979490: $25,333 rev / $1,333 disc / 24.8% labor / 11.3% purch / 63.5% GM / $16,095 GP), member click-through, Esc/X/backdrop close, solo-project note, no-project card without the section, save round-trip carrying R44 code with no live overlay markup; Chromium screenshots confirm the old clipping and the new card. June data carries 540 multi-job projects. Whole-file diff vs R43 = 10 intended hunks (overlay+pjsec CSS, mobile CSS, header/footer stamps, footer changelog, toggleDetail->showDetail/pjRollup, Instructions section 9). build.js and close.js run VERBATIM.  || R45 (2026-08-07): Review Desk repaint fix + reflag-on-sync + per-system HVAC install assumption + rebuilt Pay Plan tab. Reproduced the desk failure end-to-end in jsdom against a wired CFG with a mocked private-repo state.json: sync pulled 5 approvals / 3 watch / 8 log entries, and the R44 desk still reported 'No review activity recorded yet' with 0 approved / 0 watchlist while the Jobs tab's own pills read 'Approved (0) | Watchlist (0)' until clicked, at which point they immediately corrected to 'Approved (5) | Watchlist (3)' — the exact asymmetry reported. On R45 the desk populates before any click (HVAC 3 approved / 1 watch, Plumbing 2 / 1, reviewer table AG/RP/TR/EO, open queue 171 -> 164) and repaints again on tab open. A/B vs R44 on mature June: jobs 3,902 / $6,087,636 / GM 55.3%, flag set identical (171), per-job rev+purch+labor+GM+instTop identical, all 71 pre-existing summary keys x 3 scopes identical, 9/12 rendered panes byte-identical (the 3 Summary panes differ only by the Reconciliation label). RAW grows 9,745 bytes for the new disc `units` map — the single intended payload change. snap.js + ages.py run verbatim on R45 and reproduce the R44 ledger exactly. gates 6/6.

mem.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Margin Variables' tab — 'Other Revenue' block (Membership row: Revenue $ + Purchases $, branch monthly totals)

mem.behavior: MTD = monthly x calendar elapsedFrac; pace carries the full monthly figure exactly; cost lands in Purchases; all margins/% re-base to TOTAL revenue; mem absent/invalid → renders exactly R37

r39.caps: service-side 480 min/job, install 720 min/job; CB/WT worked entirely by an install crew inherit the install cap
r39.time_source: Job Costing 'Start of Working Time' / 'End of Working Time' x crew count from 'Assigned Technicians'; bucket median backfills the ~2% of jobs with no usable stamps
r39.rate: scope GP (and CP) split between service and install by share of job-attributed margin, divided by that side's man-minutes; lost minutes priced by the side of the tech who logged them
r39.caveat: opportunity cost at current productivity - not recoverable cash

r45.review_desk_fix: THE bug: `const PPUI = (()=>{...})()` binds in the global LEXICAL environment, which is NOT a property of window, so STX.pull()'s completion guard `if(window.PPUI&&PPUI.stateChanged)` evaluated undefined on EVERY load since R17 and the post-sync repaint never fired. Under a wired CFG, STATE0 ships empty (SKILL 3c), so the desk painted once against empty state and stayed there. The Jobs tab masked it — its view pills, filter chips and column sorts all call renderJobs(), so Approved/Watchlist self-healed on first click, which is exactly the symptom Stephen reported. Fix: `window.PPUI=PPUI;` after the IIFE, plus setTab() now calls renderDesk() when the desk tab is opened (independent second path).
r45.reflag_fix: checkReflags() ran only under recompute(fromIngest) — i.e. only on a manual file drop. On the nightly site every viewer loads RAW and never drops a file, so approved-then-went-bad was never detected and the desk's 'Approved then went bad' row could not light up. stateChanged() now runs it once when synced state lands, guarded to nightly data (!S.manual, pay+disc present). Idempotent: it consumes the approval it reflags. Verified: honest snapshots survive with ZERO reflags and ZERO state PUTs; stale snapshots reflag correctly.
r45.install_per_system: HVAC assumed install pay is now book rate x systems sold. Count comes from parseDisc: priced lines with Item GL Group Name 'HVAC- Replacement', summed by Item Quantity into families sp/pk/ms (mini tested FIRST — 'Mini-Split' contains 'split'); blank/zero quantity on a priced line reads as 1. INSTDEF.fam limits it to the six EQUIPMENT-system job types (4 Splits, Package, Mini-Split); INSTDEF.qtyCap=6. Duct-System, Partial, Insulation and Clean/Seal/IAQ are DELIBERATELY excluded — their invoice quantity is inches / square footage / scope, not a unit count (measured: an Insulation job reads quantity 6 against $228 of real pay, which would over-assume by $1,128). Plumbing needs no multiplier — 8% of revenue already scales with the sale.
r45.install_verification: June 2026: 127 priced system lines parsed; 11 of 326 HVAC book-rate install jobs are multi-system (nine 2-system, two 3-system, 3.4%). Exact book-vs-posted agreement rises 151 -> 160 of 315 paid jobs with ZERO new over-assumptions (the only 2 over-assumed jobs were already over-assumed at x1). Synthetic young clock (as-of 2026-07-01) with install pay zeroed on the 7 in-window multi-system jobs: R44 assumes $9,100, R45 assumes $20,900 — $11,800 previously invisible; worst single job 544995 (3 systems, $30K) read GM 58.1% under R44 vs the honest 49.1%. Flag set unchanged (171 both), pending-materials accrual identical to the cent (the R42 netting invariant holds).
r45.pay_plan_tab: Variables -> Pay Plan rebuilt as documentation a newcomer can follow: 4 quick-reference cards, pay-code decoder, commission ladder + discount-cliff bar chart, HVAC flat-rate book table with a 'x systems?' column beside Plumbing's flat 8% + effective-%-of-revenue bar chart, 4 worked examples, assumed-install timeline (day 0-14 floor -> day 15 actuals), payroll calendar + stub-length table, pay-code landing-curve chart, and a sourced June-2026 verification block. Static HTML + a scoped .pp* CSS block; no script, no bindings, no engine contact.
r45.summary_keys_added: instMultiN (jobs with a top-up AND >1 system), instMultiSys (total systems on those jobs) — both 0 on a mature month.
r45.untouched: parsers otherwise, project/tier math, buckets, GM/CP, accrual vector + R42 netting, Handoff, Trends, flag definitions, renderJobs, the job card and project rollup. build.js, close.js, snap.js and ages.py run VERBATIM (snap.js on R45 reproduces 171 flagged / 126 HVAC / 45 Plumb / $299,421, identical to R44).
